	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_callrate min = 0.4 max = 1.2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_ST = 0.01 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_AS = -0.03 }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = HOL } HOL = { COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -3 } COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DEN } DEN = { COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -3 } COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = IRE } IRE = { COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -3 } COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = FRA } FRA = { COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -3 } COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes } }

# Any scope. D3 Preferential Agreements: Spain, Israel enters into force for all members.
COLDWAR_EC_D3_apply = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_EC D3 in force"
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_HM = 0.01 }
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SPR SPR = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				set_temp_variable = { sender_nation = THIS.id }
				set_temp_variable = { receiver_nation = SPR.id }
				set_temp_variable = { remove_agreement = 0 }
				set_improved_trade_agreement = yes
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR ISR = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				set_temp_variable = { sender_nation = THIS.id }
				set_temp_variable = { receiver_nation = ISR.id }
				set_temp_variable = { remove_agreement = 0 }
				set_improved_trade_agreement = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SPR SPR = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			SPR = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_D3_spr_isr } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR ISR = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			ISR = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_D3_spr_isr } }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_AS = -0.01 }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = ITA } ITA = { add_to_variable = { cwec_m_AS = -0.01 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = FRA } FRA = { add_to_variable = { cwec_m_AS = -0.01 } } }
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_D3
}

# Any scope. D8 The EC-CMEA Joint Declaration enters into force for all members.
COLDWAR_EC_D8_apply = {
	# once only: the COMECON declaration (D5) may have put it into force already
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_D8 } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_EC D8 in force"
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_HM = 0.02 }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -1 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_WE = 0.03 }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_cw_dirty
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_D8_usa } }
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_D8
		# the same declaration of the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance (COMECON file D5) enters into force with it
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_initialized NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_done_D5 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_D5_apply = yes
		}
	}
}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = 43 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_C3_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = 44 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_C4_apply = yes
	}

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = 45 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_C5_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = 47 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_C7_apply = yes
	}

		COLDWAR_EC_C8_apply = yes

# Any scope. The last member that blocked a majority with its vital interest loses support.
COLDWAR_EC_special_last_veto = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_last_vetoer > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_last_vetoer = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwec_last_vetoer = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -5 } COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. A Union of States pleases national governments.
COLDWAR_EC_special_gaullist_support = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = nationalist original_tag = FRA } } set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 5 } COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. The EMS replaces the Snake.
COLDWAR_EC_special_snake_to_ems = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ems }
	}
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_snake
}

# Any scope. Joining the currency costs support (applied on joining).
COLDWAR_EC_special_emu_support = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_emu_support_cost
}

# Any scope. Budget correction for the member in the context.
COLDWAR_EC_special_rebate = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_rebate = global.cwec_ctx_target }
}

# Any scope. Association agreement with the country in the context.
COLDWAR_EC_special_association = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
			COLDWAR_EC_become_associate = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 5 }
			COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			hidden_effect = {
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwec_members
					set_temp_variable = { sender_nation = THIS.id }
					set_temp_variable = { receiver_nation = PREV.id }
					set_temp_variable = { remove_agreement = 0 }
					set_improved_trade_agreement = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Common position on the country in the context: 1 support, 2 condemn.
COLDWAR_EC_special_position = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_opt = 1 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_position_support } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			# native opinion target scopes: the member (PREV inside the target) condemns, the target resents the member
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
					PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_position_condemn } }
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_position_condemned }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { OR = { original_tag = SOV original_tag = POL original_tag = CZE original_tag = HUN original_tag = ROM original_tag = BUL original_tag = DDR } }
					has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 1 }
				mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Community loan to the member in the context.
COLDWAR_EC_special_loan = {
	COLDWAR_EC_start_loan = yes
}
